raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`--enable-mixed-chunk` crashed with `NotImplementedError` on Ascend NPUs for anything beyond plain MHA: `AscendAttnBackend.forward_mixed` rejected batches carrying indexer `topk_indices` (DSA models, e.g. GLM-5.2), and its own FIA call for the plain-MHA case misread the paged-KV geometry (FIA pools expose per-layer views shaped `[P*ps, 1, H, D]`, so `block_size` derived from `k_cache.shape` is 1), and did not handle attention-sink layers or DP token padding.

A mixed batch is just a varlen extend batch whose rows have heterogeneous extend lengths (decode rows are 1-token extends), so no new kernel capability is required — the extend routing already covers all of the above (per-row query/KV lengths, `sparse_mode=3`, SWA block tables, `learnable_sink`, DP padding trim).

The `ASCEND_USE_FIA=0 and qk_head_dim > 128` guard is likewise obsolete: it dates back to the `torch_npu._npu_paged_attention_splitfuse` implementation (#12491, head_dim limit 128), but `forward_mixed` now always calls `npu_fused_infer_attention_score` (#15518), which supports `qk_head_dim` up to 256 — the flag no longer selects the operator on this path.

## Modifications

- `AscendAttnBackend.forward_mixed` (`ascend_backend.py`): rewritten as a single guard plus full delegation to `forward_extend`, so mixed batches traverse exactly the same routing as prefill batches — DSA sparse path (GLM-5.2), FIA v2 + `learnable_sink` + SWA block tables (MiMo-V2.5), plain TND FIA (MHA). Also picks up the DP token padding trim the old path lacked.
- Drop the stale `ASCEND_USE_FIA=0 and qk_head_dim > 128` rejection; `forward_mixed` now raises only for the pure MLA backend (without DSA).
- `modelslim.py`: fall back to the fused prefix when the scheme lookup misses after `packed_modules_mapping` rewrites it; fused-layout checkpoints (e.g. MiMo-V2.5 `fused_qkv`) otherwise silently degrade to bf16.

## Accuracy Tests

```
# high performance cpu
echo performance | tee /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor
sysctl -w vm.swappiness=0
sysctl -w kernel.numa_balancing=0
sysctl -w kernel.sched_migration_cost_ns=50000
# bind cpu
export SGLANG_SET_CPU_AFFINITY=1
unset https_proxy
unset http_proxy
unset HTTPS_PROXY
unset HTTP_PROXY
unset ASCEND_LAUNCH_BLOCKING
# cann
source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh
source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh

export STREAMS_PER_DEVICE=32
export SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT=600
export SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2=1
export SGLANG_ENABLE_OVERLAP_PLAN_STREAM=1
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=500
export DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE=2500
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=AIV
export HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=lo
export GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME=lo
export TRANSFORMERS_VERBOSITY=error
export DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_ROUND=72
export DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_PER_ROUND_TOKENS=1024
export DEEPEP_NORMAL_COMBINE_ENABLE_LONG_SEQ=1
export DEEP_NORMAL_MODE_USE_INT8_QUANT=1
export DEEPEP_HYBRID_DEPLOYMENT=1
export SGLANG_NPU_ATTN_BACKEND_NEEDS_CPU_SEQ_LENS=0

sglang serve \
        --model-path $MODEL_PATH \
        --attention-backend ascend \
        --device npu \
        --tp-size 16 \
        --nnodes 1 \
        --dp-size 2 --enable-dp-attention --enable-dp-lm-head \
        --trust-remote-code \
        --mem-fraction-static 0.8 \
        --served-model-name $MODEL_PATH \
        --max-running-requests 64 \
        --quantization modelslim \
        --moe-a2a-backend deepep --deepep-mode auto \
        --load-balance-method round_robin \
        --cuda-graph-bs-decode 8 16 24 32 \
        --enable-mixed-chunk \
```

```
┌──────────────┬───────────┬────────────┬──────────┬───────┬─────────┐
│ Model        │ Dataset   │ Metric     │ Subset   │   Num │ Score   │
├──────────────┼───────────┼────────────┼──────────┼───────┼─────────┤
│ GLM-5.2-w4a8 │ GSM8K     │ Accuracy ↑ │ main     │   200 │ 97.5%   │
└──────────────┴───────────┴────────────┴──────────┴───────┴─────────┘

2026-10-30 02:14:08 - evalscope - INFO: Overall perf table:
Model         Dataset      Num  Avg Lat    Avg TTFT    Avg TPOT    Avg Thpt      Avg In    Avg Out
------------  ---------  -----  ---------  ----------  ----------  ----------  --------  ---------
GLM-5.2-w4a8  GSM8K        200  29.111 s   2566.6 ms   228.7 ms    4.08 tok/s       584        119
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No impact. The change only activates a path that previously raised immediately, and mixed batches reuse the existing prefill varlen path with no extra metadata construction; non-mixed paths are untouched.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+        sinks: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
     ):
-        if (

-            or self.use_mla
-            or (not self.use_fia and layer.qk_head_dim > 128)
-        ):
+        if self.use_mla and topk_indices is None:
             raise NotImplementedError(
-                "The 'enable-mixed-chunk' feature is currently unsupported in the following scenarios: "
-                "1. When using the MLA backend on Ascend NPU devices, "
-                "2. When using the deepseekv3.2 model on Ascend NPU devices, "
-                "3. When the environment variable ASCEND_USE_FIA is set to 0 and qk_head_dim exceeds 128 on Ascend NPU devices."
-            )
-        if save_kv_cache:
-            self.token_to_kv_pool.set_kv_buffer(
-                layer,
-                KVWriteLoc(
-                    forward_batch.out_cache_loc,
-                    self.forward_metadata.swa_out_cache_loc,
-                ),
-                k,
-                v,
+                "The 'enable-mixed-chunk' feature is currently unsupported when using the MLA backend (without DSA sparse attention) on Ascend NPU devices."
             )
-        k_cache = self.token_to_kv_pool.get_key_buffer(layer.layer_id)
-        v_cache = self.token_to_kv_pool.get_value_buffer(layer.layer_id)
-        num_block, block_size, _, _ = k_cache.shape
-        key = k_cache.view(num_block, block_size, -1)
-        value = v_cache.view(num_block, block_size, -1)
-
-        query = q.reshape(-1, layer.tp_q_head_num, layer.qk_head_dim)
-
-        attn_output, _ = torch.ops.npu.npu_fused_infer_attention_score(
-            query,
-            key,
-            value,
-            num_heads=layer.tp_q_head_num,
-            num_key_value_heads=layer.tp_k_head_num,
-            input_layout="TND",
-            block_size=block_size,
-            block_table=self.forward_metadata.block_tables,
-            atten_mask=self.mix_mask,
-            sparse_mode=3,
-            actual_seq_lengths=self.forward_metadata.seq_lens_list_cumsum,
-            actual_seq_lengths_kv=self.forward_metadata.seq_lens_cpu_int,
-            scale=layer.scaling,
-        )
-
-        return attn_output.view(
-            attn_output.shape[0], layer.tp_q_head_num * layer.v_head_dim
+        # A mixed batch is a varlen extend batch (decode rows are 1-token
+        # extends), so reuse the extend path
+        return self.forward_extend(
+            q,
+            k,
+            v,
+            layer,
+            forward_batch,
+            save_kv_cache,
+            q_rope=q_rope,
+            k_rope=k_rope,
+            topk_indices=topk_indices,
+            sinks=sinks,
         )

@@ -281,6 +281,10 @@ def get_quant_method(
                     proj_name, packed_modules_mapping_subset[proj_name][0]
                 )
             prefix_in_quant_config = self._resolve_quant_prefix(prefix_in_quant_config)
+            if prefix_in_quant_config + ".weight" not in self.quant_description:
+                # Fused-layout checkpoints (e.g. MiMo-V2.5 fused_qkv) keep the
+                # fused name in the quant description; fall back to it.
+                prefix_in_quant_config = self._resolve_quant_prefix(prefix)
             if self.is_layer_skipped(
                 prefix, packed_modules_mapping_subset
